'''Transport Depot''' was a transportation hub in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], offering transport to almost any other settlement on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. It was also the beginning and end-point of the [[Circle Route]] around the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]]. The proprietor, [[Yvonne Targis]], worked for [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]], who used the depot as a drop-off point for [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]].

Transport Depot was supposed to launch a transport along the Circle Route every three days, but Yvonne Targis would only allow the [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series astromech droid]] pilot to leave if there were at least four beings with paid tickets. Even then, the transports are rarely on schedule.<ref name="GG7" />
